title: Strategic terrain
description: Strategic terrain types (steppe, woods, mountain, water, ...), keyed by ID: vehicle movement hours, visibility class, and the biome that selects the tactical terrain and prefab tables for battles on a tile of this terrain (spec STR-005, STR-006, STR-008, STR-022, STR-023, STR-095). Roads lie on top of a terrain and are not records here (STR-006: strategic-rules roadMoveHours); a road tile takes this terrain's visibility (roads have none of their own). On-foot hours: strategic-rules onFootHours.

id.description: Record ID, equals its key (steppe, woods, mountain, water)

passable.description: STR-006: false = no squad enters off-road (water: only along a road over a bridge or ford, or by an amphibious vehicle or helicopter)

moveHours.description: STR-006/STR-032: hours for a ground vehicle to enter a tile of this terrain off-road; null = vehicles enter only along a road (mountain) or not at all (water). Design: steppe 2, woods 3

offRoadRated.description: STR-032: the vehicle's off-road rating lowers moveHours here (design: steppe and woods)

visibility.description: STR-008/STR-024: visibility class used by detection and evasion, also on road tiles of this terrain; null = none (water: design gives none). Design: steppe open, woods low, mountain low

biome.description: STR-095: biome passed to the tactical generator in tactical_map_request.region.biome

tacticalTerrainTable.description: STR-095: names the tactical terrain table the tactical generator draws from for battles on a tile of this terrain (TAC)

prefabTable.description: STR-095: names the prefab table the tactical generator draws from for battles on a tile of this terrain (TAC)
